【原视频简介】
How I turn a hex nut into beautiful flower ring - handmade jewelry

In this video, I’ll show you how I transform a brass hex nut into a beautiful flower ring. This is part of a series on creating jewelry from unconventional materials; crafting a ring from a brass hex nut is quite challenging because the alloy—containing zinc, nickel, and copper—is hard to melt and difficult to shape. Nevertheless, I’ll turn it into a lovely floral ring. The design is simple, featuring petals inspired by the *Jasminum sambac* flower, an emerald center, and tsavorite accents on the band—making it a stunning piece to wear. As with my other videos, I use simple tools and techniques, so you can create your own jewelry at home by following along. You can also order this ring in materials like silver, gold, or palladium, or request a personalized design; feel free to contact me via my website or Etsy shop. Thank you so much for watching!
